name: S&P Global - Adaptive Retrieval
description: Adaptive Retrieval is designed for open-ended, complex workflows where the data path isn't predefined. Submit a natural language query and the system dynamically routes across S&P Global data sources, from Market Intelligence to Energy data, generating queries and assembling cited results automatically. Built by Kensho, S&P Global's AI innovation engine, the solution is ideal for deep research, multi-step analysis, and autonomous agent workflows. Can be used alongside S&P Global - Deterministic Retrieval for teams that need both structured and flexible data access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add S&P Global - Adaptive Retrieval to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add S&P Global - Adaptive Retrieval to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://grounding.kensho.com/integrations/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
